items.stem: Which prompt will most likely produce a usable first draft?

options.rationale: Too vague; no audience, goal or format.

options.text: 'Write a one-page update for executives on project risks, in bullet points.'
options.rationale: Correct: audience, goal, format and length are specified.
Gives the AI no usable constraints.
Unfocused and not tied to a goal.

items.explanation: Correct: specifying audience, goal, format and length gives the AI the constraints it needs.

items.stem: Which TWO checks should you run before sending an AI-drafted report? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: AI can produce confident but wrong facts.

options.text: Confirm no confidential information is exposed
options.rationale: Correct: confidentiality must be checked before sharing.

options.text: Assume the AI voice matches your brand automatically
options.rationale: Voice must be checked and aligned, not assumed.

options.text: Skip review because AI rarely errs
options.rationale: AI output requires review; errors are common.

items.explanation: Correct: fact-checking claims and confirming no confidential data is exposed are both essential.

items.stem: After AI shortens a report, what is the key risk to check?

options.text: Important points or caveats may have been dropped
options.rationale: Correct: summaries can omit essential detail.

options.text: The document will be too long
options.rationale: Shortening makes it shorter, not longer.

items.explanation: Correct: shortening can drop critical points, so verify nothing essential was lost.
